question: Should this sprint task enter ideation to remove only the public gate eligibility ceremony while preserving the private fail-closed authority predicate at consume and terminal delivery boundaries?

artifacts.summary: Backlog seed and acceptance criteria define a v1 cut: remove the public eligibility command and its operator vocabulary, retain atomic internal guards, and prove the real lifecycle plus negative controls. The sprint index lists this boundary as a required outcome after the moving-target owner lands.
